captions.detailed: A BMX-style freestyle crankset featuring a grey central spindle with a black bottom bracket shell, a grey-colored steel chainring with wide teeth, and two black crank arms offset by 180 degrees. Attached to the ends of the crank arms are two black platform pedals with grey pedal pins. The entire crankset assembly rotates continuously around the spindle axis, while each individual pedal rotates continuously about its respective spindle axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a BMX freestyle crankset. It must feature a central axle spindle, a thick single chainring, two offset crank arms, and two platform pedals. Implement continuous rotational joints for the main spindle and each of the pedals, using appropriate dark grey and black materials.
captions.factory: Construct a central spindle using a Cylinder primitive, and encase its center with a larger Cylinder to represent the bottom bracket shell. Create a chainring by patterning rectangular teeth around a thin cylinder, then subtracting rectangular cutouts for the sprocket spokes. Model the crank arms by combining box and cylinder primitives, offsetting them by 180 degrees at opposite ends of the spindle. Build each platform pedal from a flat box with smaller rectangular traction ridges, and attach them to the crank arms via continuous revolute joints.
